note: 47-acre SRA on the Missouri River at Nebraska City, with two boat ramps. The camping loop sits on the lawn north of the main ramp, set back about 100 m from the river. Small playground. --Claude
summary: Booking confirmed first-come only. Phone to add 402-873-1035 (grid). Riverview confirmed: the camping loop is ~100-120 m from the ~300 m-wide Missouri across its own loop road and an open lawn. Pin is on the ramp lot ~150 m SE of the loop (optional re-pin). Hookups/pad count unverified.
flags: PHONE to add (top-level, by hand): 402-873-1035 (NGPC 2025 grid row). The entry has none.

WATERFRONT riverview confirmed (no change): on NAIP the camping loop (RVs parked inside it) is ~100-120 m from the Missouri's bank; between them are the loop's own east road and an open mown lawn with a few trees, then a thin fringe at the bank. Open view of the river (~300 m wide here), but past the ~50 m bound and across the loop road, so not riverfront. No levee between the loop and the river on imagery; the levee/backwater channel lies west of the access road.
PIN ~150 m: stored 40.6915,-95.8485 is on the main boat-ramp parking lot; the camping loop centre is ~40.69218,-95.85007. Optional re-pin.
FLOOD HISTORY: the site flooded badly in 2019; NAIP shows the loop in use with RVs, so it is open, but I could not read a current NGPC status page (outdoornebraska.gov blocked).
